title: Two-sided eventual ball-mass bounds ⇒ Θ^n(μ, x) = a
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on Euclidean N, x ∈ Euclidean N and a ∈ [0, ∞]; write ω_n = unitBallVolume n. Assume (i) for every c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < a · ω_n, eventually as t → 0⁺, c · ENNReal.ofReal(t)^n ≤ μ(closedBall x t); and (ii) for every c ∈ [0, ∞] with a · ω_n < c, eventually as t → 0⁺, μ(closedBall x t) ≤ c · ENNReal.ofReal(t)^n. Then HasDensity n μ x a, i.e. μ(B̄_t(x))/(ω_n t^n) → a as t ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < a * unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall x t)) → (∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, a * unitBallVolume n < c → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ (closedBall x t) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n) → HasDensity n μ x a
